leadText:
Slowpoke Island (Japanese: ヤドンの島 Island) is an -exclusive location featured in Slowking's Crowning!. The island is inhabited by a large group of , with a acting as the ruler. 

 and Goh visited the island with Goh hoping to catch a Slowpoke. Goh quickly shifted his attention to Slowking, only to fail to catch it when Slowking stopped the with its powers. Instead, Slowking was more interested in Ash's noodles and proceeded to take the noodle cup whilst swapping its crown, which landed on Ash's head, taking over his mind. Goh, , and managed to get the crown off Ash's head but it kept landing on the others' heads, causing them to try to get the crown off each other's head. This was stopped when Goh's crashed onto the island, having earlier been launched into space during the Magikarp High Jump Competition.

Ash and Goh visited Slowpoke Island once more in An Evolution in Taste!. Whilst there, Goh caught himself a . During their visit, another island full of Galarian Slowpoke with a Galarian Slowbro and Slowking landed there. The Galarian Slowking's Shellder crown ended possessing Ash and making him rap, and the regular Slowking's crown did the same to Goh, resulting in a . Afterwards, Galarian Slowking's group planted a Galarica tree on the island and left on their floating island.
